title: Keryx stack catalog install manifest
description: Declares the profiles, modules, components, and per-target install state consumed by `keryx skills install`/`doctor`/`uninstall` for the stack-aware skills & rules catalog (W1). Implemented as of flow 309 (Wave 2): `src/gdskills/manifest/` (`manifest.ts`/`plan.ts`/`apply.ts`/`doctor.ts`/`uninstall.ts`/`state.ts`) loads and validates the bundled `install-manifest.json` against this schema, and `$defs/installState` is the on-disk shape of `.metaproject/data/skills/install-state/<target>.json` — see workstreams/W1-stack-catalog.md for the full install-plan/install-state/doctor/uninstall lifecycle.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest format version. Bumped only on a breaking shape change; consumers must fail closed on an unrecognised major.

profiles.description: Named install profiles. Keys are profile ids referenced by `keryx skills install --profile <id>`.

modules.description: Named install modules. Keys are module ids referenced from `profiles[*].modules` and `components[*].modules`.

components.description: Named install components, e.g. `lang:python`, `framework:react`. Keys are component ids referenced from `profiles[*].components`.

installState.description: Optional embedded snapshot of the last recorded install state for one target. `keryx skills doctor` and `keryx skills install --state <file>` read/write this shape as a standalone document sharing this same $defs; it is optional inside a manifest document and mandatory as the top-level shape of a per-target `.metaproject/data/skills/install-state/<target>.json` file.

id.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier, max 64 chars, matching the Agent Skills open standard's `name` constraint reused here for consistency.

componentId.description: Namespaced component id, e.g. `lang:python`, `framework:react`, `tool:docker`, `capability:sql`, `baseline:core`. Prefixes align 1:1 with the `component.family` enum below (`baseline`, `lang`↔`language`, `framework`, `capability`, `tool`, `agent`, `skill`).

harnessId.description: Canonical harness id list, shared with schemas/portable-bundle.schema.json and schemas/harness-capability-matrix.schema.json (both keep this same enum) and defined by workstreams/W5-multi-harness.md's Target matrix. `keryx-shell` denotes Keryx's own agent shell rather than a host harness.

modules.description: Module ids installed unconditionally by this profile.

components.description: Component ids this profile installs when detected or explicitly requested via `--with`. Example profiles: minimal (module set only, no components), core (common rules + orchestration/quality/review modules, no stack components), a per-stack profile (e.g. `python`, `react`) adding exactly that stack's components, and full (every registered component).

stackDetectionAware.description:
When true, `keryx skills install --profile

` intersects `components` with `keryx stack detect` output instead of installing all listed components unconditionally; an uncertain detection result includes every component (fail open, matching src/review/stack.ts's uncertain-always-means-included rule).

kind.description: What this module installs. `hook-runtime` modules must list only targets with a real hook surface (W5 capability matrix state `native` or `adapter`), never `instruction-only` or `unsupported`.

paths.description: Repo-relative source paths (files or globs) this module installs from the bundled tree.

targets.description: Harnesses this module is written for. Export/adapter honesty is cross-checked against the W5 capability matrix at install-plan time — a target this module lists but the matrix marks `unsupported` fails the plan.

dependencies.description: Other module ids that must be installed first.

defaultInstall.description: Whether a profile that references this module installs it without an explicit `--with` flag.

cost.description: Relative context/token footprint once installed, surfaced in `keryx skills install --dry-run` output so an operator can budget a profile.

stability.description: Deprecated modules may still be installed explicitly but are excluded from `full` unless `--include-deprecated` is passed.

family.description: Groups components for catalog display and for the stack-pack table in workstreams/W1-stack-catalog.md. Aligns 1:1 with the `componentId` prefix (`baseline`, `language`↔`lang:`, `framework`, `capability`, `tool`, `agent`, `skill`).

modules.description: Module ids this component bundles. A component is purely a named grouping of modules — it installs no file directly.

detectionMarkers.description: Marker files, extensions, or manifest dependency names that `keryx stack detect` uses to recommend this component. Empty for components with no deterministic detector (recommended manually only).

origin.description: `authored` = written by a Keryx maintainer; `generated` = produced by the W2 per-stack agent compiler from a W1 stack pack; `imported` = brought in via `keryx bundle import` (W4) from an Agent-Skills-standard-conformant external catalog; `learned` = graduated from the W3 self-learning loop after human accept.

sourceRef.description: Free-text pointer to the generating flow, import bundle id, or learned-pattern id. Required in practice for every non-`authored` origin, kept optional here so hand-authored components need not fill it.

profile.description: Profile id last applied, if install was profile-driven.

installedModules.description: One record per module Keryx has written for this target. `keryx skills uninstall` and `keryx skills doctor` only ever touch files listed here.

surface.description: Optional W5 surface discriminator for this record, letting a single target hold separately tracked install-state per surface (e.g. a `block` hook vs. an `instructions` file for the same harness).

writtenPaths.description: Absolute or project-relative paths Keryx wrote for this module on this target.

sha256.description: Map of written path -> sha256 of the content Keryx wrote, used by `doctor` to detect user edits (drift) before an uninstall or reinstall touches the file.

managedSentinel.description: Whether the written file(s) carry a `_keryxManaged` sentinel. Files sharing a host config with user content (e.g. a merged settings.json block) must be true; a file Keryx owns outright may still be true for consistency.

keryxVersion.description: Additive (W5-b, `keryx integrations`): the running Keryx version at the moment this record was written. Optional so a pre-W5-b install-state document (or a hand-authored one) stays valid; consumed by `keryx integrations doctor`'s drift reports ("installed by Keryx X on <date> and is now missing/invalid").

installedAt.description: Additive (W5-b, `keryx integrations`): ISO date-time this specific record was last written (install or re-install), distinct from the install-state document's own top-level `recordedAt`, which reflects the whole document's last write. Optional for the same reason as `keryxVersion`; consumed by `keryx integrations doctor`'s drift reports.
